body.name: ordered LDL certificate
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Cert}(\theta,T,t)\iff [\,t\text{ orders }T,\ \bar Q_{tt}\succ0,\ \bar Q_{tt}=L_tD_tL_t^{\mathsf T},\ L_t\text{ unit lower triangular},\ D_t\text{ diagonal positive},\ \Lambda_{e,t}=L_t^{-1}P_t\Delta_eP_t^{\mathsf T}L_t^{-\mathsf T}\text{ diagonal and entrywise nonnegative for every }1\le e\le E\,]\), where \(\bar Q=\sum_{e=1}^E\Delta_e\) and \(\bar Q_{tt}=P_t\bar QP_t^{\mathsf T}\).
